name: visual-pozdr-frontend
description: Local desktop video greeting system for events
author: Visual Pozdr

scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --mac zip
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle-backend && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.desktop:package:portable: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.yml --win portable
scripts.desktop:package:audit: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle-backend && electron-builder --win --dir --config.directories.output=../artifacts/size-audit
